title: erodium petraeum var. crispum
intro: Erodium petraeum var. crispum, commonly known as the alpine stork's bill, is a variety of flowering plant in the geranium family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Erodium petraeum var. crispum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
